title: Red Hat Security Advisory: .NET 11.0 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: .NET 11.0 for Red Hat Enterprise Linux contains an elevation of privilege vulnerability in ASP.NET Core identified as CVE-2026-114148. This security issue has been addressed in an update to .NET 11.0 RC 3. The update also includes bug fixes and enhancements. The vulnerability affects multiple .NET versions including 8.0, 9.0, 10.0, and 11.0. Red Hat has released a security advisory with an important severity rating and recommends applying the update to remediate the issue.
